title: Op-Ed Editorial
subtitle: A persuasive opinion piece on remote work — for English learners

sentences.en: The debate over remote work has, somewhat predictably, calcified into two opposing camps that talk past each other.
sentences.target: The debate over remote work has, somewhat predictably, calcified into two opposing camps that talk past each other.

sentences.en: Executives invoke vague claims about culture and collaboration; workers cite hard data on productivity and well-being.
sentences.target: Executives invoke vague claims about culture and collaboration; workers cite hard data on productivity and well-being.

sentences.en: Yet both sides, in their certainty, often overlook the more interesting question of how work itself is changing.
sentences.target: Yet both sides, in their certainty, often overlook the more interesting question of how work itself is changing.

sentences.en: It is no longer a meaningful question whether remote work is, in some abstract sense, 'better' than in-person work.
sentences.target: It is no longer a meaningful question whether remote work is, in some abstract sense, 'better' than in-person work.

sentences.en: What matters far more is which configurations support which kinds of cognitive labor for which kinds of teams.
sentences.target: What matters far more is which configurations support which kinds of cognitive labor for which kinds of teams.

sentences.en: A junior designer learning her craft benefits enormously from sitting beside more experienced colleagues.
sentences.target: A junior designer learning her craft benefits enormously from sitting beside more experienced colleagues.

sentences.en: A senior engineer doing deep architectural work, by contrast, may produce her best output in long stretches of isolation.
sentences.target: A senior engineer doing deep architectural work, by contrast, may produce her best output in long stretches of isolation.

sentences.en: Forcing both into the same office five days a week serves neither — and yet that is precisely what many firms now demand.
sentences.target: Forcing both into the same office five days a week serves neither — and yet that is precisely what many firms now demand.

sentences.en: The most thoughtful organizations are quietly building hybrid models tailored to specific roles, projects, and life stages.
sentences.target: The most thoughtful organizations are quietly building hybrid models tailored to specific roles, projects, and life stages.

sentences.en: Until the broader conversation moves past slogans and toward such nuance, both sides will continue arguing in circles.
sentences.target: Until the broader conversation moves past slogans and toward such nuance, both sides will continue arguing in circles.

sentences.en: The real question is not where we work, but how we design work that respects both our humanity and our craft.
sentences.target: The real question is not where we work, but how we design work that respects both our humanity and our craft.
